name: orders
description: Take orders by chat: catalog, quotes with promos and delivery, orders saved with customer and address, stock kept up to date. Data in .lampson/orders/ of the project.

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: The store's catalog: products (sku, name, price, unit, stock, notes, promos), hours, delivery and payment methods. Read it before talking about products, prices, stock, delivery or hours.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Prices a cart exactly: lines, promos and packs applied, delivery fee and total, plus any item without enough stock. Use it for every total you tell the customer; never add up yourself.

delivery.description: delivery to an address, or pickup at the store

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Places the order once the customer CONFIRMED the summary: saves it with an order number, saves the customer (name, phone, address) and lowers the stock. Prices are computed here again from the catalog.

address.description: street, number, floor/apartment and any reference — required for delivery

payment.description: one of the catalog's payment methods

when.description: when the customer wants it, if they said (e.g. 'today 18 h'); empty = as soon as possible

notes.description: anything else the store must know

tools.name: find_customer
tools.description: Looks up a returning customer by phone (or by name): saved address and last orders.

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: An order by its number (e.g. P-0003): items, total, delivery and status.
